onboarding.title: Set up {project}
onboarding.lead: Studio runs inside this project. Connect the chat agent, add model keys for your workflows, and pick where to start.

project.title: Project
project.description: Studio serves the project it was launched in. To work on another project, run the same command in its folder.
project.noConfig: aqven.yaml is created on first save
project.workflowCount: {count, plural, =0 {none yet} one {# workflow} other {# workflows}}

agent.title: Chat agent
agent.description: The chat runs the agent on this computer with your own subscription. No API key is needed.
agent.signInNote: Sign-in happens in the agent's own flow. Studio never reads or stores your credentials.

fix.install: Install it in Terminal, then check again

signIn.claude: Run this in Terminal, type /login, then check again
signIn.codex: Run this in Terminal, then check again

agent.defaultHint: The chat starts new conversations with this agent.
agent.noneReady: Sign in to at least one agent to use the chat.

providers.title: Model keys
providers.description: Workflow nodes call models with these keys. The first match wins: project setting, Studio setting, then the environment variable.
providers.missingNote: Workflows that call models need at least one key. You can add keys later in Settings.

workflow.existingDescription: Open one to continue where you left off.
workflow.emptyDescription: {project} has no workflows yet. Pick how you want to begin.

describe.title: Describe it to the agent
describe.description: {agent} drafts the flow, nodes and prompts as files in your project, runs aqven check and asks before each edit.
describe.placeholder: Triage support emails, look up the order, draft a reply and ask a human before sending

template.title: Start from an example
template.description: Copy a working workflow with its tests and adapt it.

blank.title: Empty workflow
blank.description: Create flow.yaml in a new flows folder with one input node and build it yourself.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lead: Settings of this project and of Studio on this computer.

agents.configurationHint: Applied to new chat sessions. The agent works in this project with the AQVEN tools and the project's CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md; your global CLI settings are not loaded.
agents.modelHint: Models this CLI reports for your account.
agents.effortHint: How much the model reasons before it answers. The list depends on the model.

reasoning.title: Reasoning in chat
reasoning.hint: How much of the agent's thinking streams into the chat.

approvals.title: Permissions
approvals.hint: When the agent stops and waits for your approval.

sandbox.title: Sandbox
sandbox.hint: What shell commands are allowed to touch.

maxTurns.title: Max turns
maxTurns.hint: Stop a request after this many agent steps.

maxBudgetUsd.title: Spend limit per request, $
maxBudgetUsd.hint: Stop when one request costs more than this.

mcp.serverDescription: External agents get the same tools as the Studio chat. The HTTP endpoint needs this launch's token, so agents connect through aqven mcp, which reads it or starts the server in the background.
mcp.claudeCodeHint: Run once in this project folder.
mcp.claudeDesktopHint: Add the same server to claude_desktop_config.json.

updates.title: Updates
updates.description: Studio ships inside the aqven package of this project's environment.
